resources.string: Operation incomplete; check storage or try again later

Data size estimates private files and preference values. External audio, shared file-format overhead and system compilation caches are excluded. Clearing cache retains saved data. Retained data can be exported, imported or deleted even when the app is not installed.
Stop %1$s and permanently delete its locally saved data, settings, private attachments and cache? The app, external audio and exported files will be retained.
Stop %1$s and clear its temporary cache? Saved data and settings will be retained.
\n\nAttachments: %1$d. Programs, audio and system grants are excluded. Playback and messaging will not start automatically.
